title: The Omacom Foundation sponsors Aurora Silicon
summary: Hardware and tokens for everyone on Aurora, and full-time pay for two maintainers for three months.

topics.angle: M4, M5 and M6 are being worked on.
Foundation money going to an independent project.
A sponsor paying for AI tokens on work Asahi does without them.

claims.text: Dj and Ryan Murray are funded full time for three months.
Aurora’s bootloader, kernel and installer began as forks of Asahi’s work, and the post thanks Asahi.
DHH says some teams may reject AI while others accelerate the same code, under MIT or GPL.
Aurora is independent: its maintainers set its technical direction, and it lives in their own repositories.
M4, M5 and M6 are all being worked on.
Fedora, Arch and NixOS setups are coming too.
The sponsorship gives hardware and tokens to everyone working on Aurora.
